selected_records.title: New Kyiv Business Centre opens in Ukraine

article.body:
New Kyiv Business Centre Opens in Ukraine - Operator and Remit Unconfirmed

The UK Ministry of Defence has announced the opening of a New Kyiv Business Centre in Ukraine. However, the available information does not specify the operator, remit, or services provided by the centre. The announcement does not yet establish whether the centre delivers any defence or public-sector capability. The affected organisation remains unidentified.
